name: Hashcat
description: Hashcat is the world's fastest and most advanced password recovery utility.

inputs.label: Attack Mode (-a):
inputs.help: Specify the attack mode.

inputs.label: Hash Type (-m):
inputs.help: Hash type ID to crack. See hashcat documentation for full list.

inputs.label: Hash File Path:
inputs.help: Path to the file containing hashes.

inputs.label: Upload Hash File:
inputs.help: Upload a file containing hashes.

inputs.label: Wordlist File Path:
inputs.help: Path to the wordlist file.

inputs.label: Upload Wordlist File:
inputs.help: Upload a wordlist file.

inputs.label: Mask (Required for -a 3, 6, 7):
inputs.help: Define the mask for brute-force/hybrid attacks.

inputs.label: Dictionary Path (-D):
inputs.help: Path to a directory containing wordlists/dictionaries.

inputs.label: Rule File Path (-r):
inputs.help: Apply password candidate modification rules from a file.

inputs.label: Increment (--increment)
inputs.help: Enable mask increment mode.

inputs.label: Print Keyspace (--keyspace)
inputs.help: Print the total keyspace and exit.

inputs.label: Session Name (--session):
inputs.help: Define a custom session name.

inputs.label: Force (--force)
inputs.help: Force hashcat to run even if critical checks fail (e.g., on VM).

inputs.label: Workload Profile (-w):
inputs.help: Configure the workload profile for your device.

inputs.label: Threads (--threads):
inputs.help: Specify the number of threads per GPU block.

inputs.label: GPU Temp Retain (--gpu-temp-retain):
inputs.help: Set the temperature threshold (in Celsius) before a speed decrease is applied.

inputs.label: Optimized Kernel (--optimized-kernel)
inputs.help: Optimize the kernel execution speed.

inputs.label: CPU Only (--gpu-skip)
inputs.help: Skip all GPU devices (effectively running on CPU if device count is 0).

inputs.label: Output File (--outfile):
inputs.help: Write cracked passwords to this file.

inputs.label: Show Status (--status)
inputs.help: Continuously display cracking status in the terminal.

inputs.label: Quiet (--quiet)
inputs.help: Suppress status updates and warnings.

inputs.label: Additional Arguments:
inputs.help: Any other hashcat arguments not covered by the GUI. Enter them exactly as you would on the command line (e.g., '--skip 1000 --limit 500').
